item.title: Legacy and Innovation in Professional Aluminum Ladders
item.description:
Legacy and Innovation in Professional Aluminum Ladders
#

Founded in 1990 in Chunghwa County, CHIAO TENG HSIN ENTERPRISE CO., LTD. has established itself as a leading manufacturer, designer, and distributor of aluminum ladders. From the outset, the company has prioritized quality, professional service, safety, and integrity, steadily expanding from domestic roots to a global presence. Today, CHIAO TENG HSIN products are found in markets such as the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Singapore, Vietnam, and Malaysia.

item.title: Custom Aluminum Ladders for Specialized Industrial Needs
item.description:
Tailored Solutions in Aluminum Ladder Manufacturing
#

Our company is dedicated to the design and production of custom aluminum ladders, offering solutions that precisely address the unique requirements of each client. Every ladder is crafted from high-strength aluminum alloy and assembled using advanced welding techniques, ensuring both structural integrity and safety. The inherent properties of aluminum—lightweight, rust resistance, and corrosion resistance—are enhanced by our meticulous fabrication process, resulting in ladders that are durable and require minimal maintenance over time.
